subject: planner: make logical ds elements public for later pkg move (#54157)
summary: This commit is a visibility/export refactor in planner: it exports DataSource and related logical-operator fields (e.g. TableInfo/PushedDownConds/AllConds/PossibleAccessPaths/PhysicalTableID/HandleCols, plus LogicalAggregation/LogicalLock fields), removes DataSource.TableInfo()/GetAllConds(), and updates in-repo callers accordingly. Review of the touched planner codepaths (stats derivation, findBestTask/skyline pruning, index-merge path generation, partition processor cloning, explain/stringer) shows changes are identifier/field renames with equivalent semantics; no Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantic/transaction/privilege/runtime risks found. Later history up to upstream/master continues the intended refactor (moving logical ops into logicalop pkg) without evidence of a follow-up fix indicating a bug in this commit.
